template.name: Computer / IT equipment – Class II – AS/NZS 3551 EST
template.desc: Class II (double insulated, no earth) computer, laptop power supply, monitor or other IT equipment. No earth continuity, mains-to-earth insulation or earth leakage test: there is no protective earth. Limits follow the other CHS templates (AS/NZS 3551 EST): protective earth 0.2 ohm or less; insulation 1 Mohm or more; touch leakage 100 uA normal and 500 uA single fault; earth leakage 500 uA normal and 1000 uA single fault. Check them against the standard before first use.

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Unplug the equipment before inspecting. Do not open the case.

items: Mains lead: plug, cable and connector undamaged; strain relief intact; two-core lead or no connection to the earth pin.
Case undamaged: no cracks, missing screws, heat marks or signs of liquid.
Ports, sockets and switches undamaged; no loose connectors.
Labels legible: model, ratings and the Class II (double square) marking.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply. Nothing needs to be connected to the equipment outlet for this step.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to accessible parts
steps.instructions: Mains pins (live and neutral linked by the ESA612) to the accessible parts. Clip the red test lead to a metal port shell or screw, or to foil wrapped around the case (link several parts together with a shorting clip). Switch the equipment on if it has a switch, and disconnect all peripherals and network cables.

steps.title: Touch leakage
steps.instructions: Equipment on, peripherals disconnected. Red test lead on an accessible metal part, or on foil wrapped around the case. No earth fault condition: Class II equipment has no earth.

steps.title: Power on and function
steps.instructions: Do this after the electrical safety tests.

items: Powers on and reaches the operating system without error messages.
Fans run and vents are clear of dust and blockage.
Screen, keyboard and pointing device work; connected peripherals work.
Equipment clean and fit for the clinical area; test label applied.
